product_name_specific: S60, V60, V60CC, S90, V90, V90CC, S90L, XC60 and XC90.
risk_description:
The 15A fuse to the low-pressure fuel pump may blow. 
As a result, the engine could stall and not be able start, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision:
The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical
units intended for such vehicles.
